title: Lord I need You
lyrics_original: Lord, I come, I confess
Bowing here I find my rest
Without You I fall apart
You're the One that guides my heart
Lord, I need You, oh, I need You
Every hour I need You
My one defense, my righteousness
Oh God, how I need You
Where sin runs deep Your grace is more
Where grace is found is where You are
Where You are, Lord, I am free
Holiness is Christ in me
Lord, I need You, oh, I need You
Every hour I need You
My one defense, my righteousness
Oh God, how I need You
So teach my song to rise to You
When temptation comes my way
When I cannot stand I'll fall on You
Jesus, You're my hope and stay
Lord, I need You, oh, I need You
Every hour I need You
My one defense, my righteousness
Oh God, how I need You
You're my one defense, my righteousness
Oh God, how I need You
My one defense, my righteousness
Oh God, how I need You
author_english: Matt Maher, Daniel Carson, Jesse Reeves, Kristian Paul Stanfill, Christy L. Nockels

bible_verses.telugu: ద్రాక్షావల్లిని నేను, తీగెలు మీరు. ఎవడు నాయందు నిలిచియుండునో నేను ఎవనియందు నిలిచి యుందునో వాడు బహుగా ఫలించును; నాకు వేరుగా ఉండి మీరేమియు చేయలేరు.
bible_verses.english: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.

bible_verses.telugu: అందుకునా కృప నీకు చాలును, బలహీనతయందు నాశక్తి పరిపూర్ణమగుచున్నదని ఆయన నాతో చెప్పెను. కాగా క్రీస్తు శక్తి నామీద నిలిచియుండు నిమిత్తము, విశేషముగా నా బలహీనతలయందె
bible_verses.english: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.' Therefore I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ’s power may rest on me.

bible_verses.telugu: నా ప్రాణము దేవుని నమ్ముకొని మౌనముగా ఉన్నది. ఆయనవలన నాకు రక్షణ కలుగును. ఆయనే నా ఆశ్రయదుర్గము ఆయనే నా రక్షణకర
bible_verses.english: Truly my soul finds rest in God; my salvation comes from him.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I come to You today confessing just how much I need You in every single hour. When I try to walk in my own strength I fall apart, but in Your presence I find true rest. Thank You that Your grace is always greater than my weakness and sin. Be my defense, my righteousness, and my guide as I abide in You today. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, I come to You today confessing just how much I need You in every single hour. When I try to walk in my own strength I fall apart, but in Your presence I find true rest. Thank You that Your grace is always greater than my weakness and sin. Be my defense, my righteousness, and my guide as I abide in You today. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Real rest begins when we stop striving to be self-sufficient and simply confess our deep need for Jesus. Every moment of our lives, both in our quiet daily tasks and our deepest struggles, His grace meets us right where we are. We do not have to perform or earn His presence; Christ Himself is our defense and our righteousness. Today, you are invited to lay down your burdens and rely on the One who faithfully guides your heart.
